notes.title: Demo Available!
notes.content:
After a wonderful visit to imagineNATIVE film & media arts festival in Toronto, where we won the New Artist in Digital + Interactive Award presented by the Indigenous Screen Office (!!).... 

[b]The official demo of Mikiwam is available for download! [/b]

In this demo, you'll play through one day in the world of Mikiwam. You'll meet and serve tea to three characters, learn a bit about the world through your dialogue choices, and see how your choice of tea affects their storyline. The ending scene diverges depending on your tea choices earlier on- you might get to flirt with the nosy Ivy, find her cooking up a plan to get the info she wants, or meet somewhere in between.

Please download and share and/or leave a comment :) <3 

we love to hear people's thoughts on the game, and we're already at work writing the rest of the story for release in 2023.

notes.title: Mikiwam at Game Devs of Color Expo
notes.content:
We are so excited to be participating in the Game Devs of Color Expo from Sep 15-18!

Check out the schedule at https://www.gamedevsofcolorexpo.com

Our team will be speaking about our development process in an interview airing Sep 17 at 1:55PM EST/10:55 AM PST.

Mikiwam is featured in the Gradient Convergence Steam Event- and just for this event we've got a temporary demo available for download. It is a very short teaser of gameplay that our two-person team worked very hard to get ready in time for the event. We hope you enjoy it and we dearly welcome feedback on what is there so far. 

Within the next few weeks, we will have a more fulsome demo available, so stay tuned! <3
